arguments.message:
Hi there,

When two people from the same company both claim to own a workspace, we can’t simply take one side’s word. This is treated as an internal company matter that must be resolved with proper documentation before any access changes are made. A human reviewer will handle the case individually, and either party can start the process by contacting our support team with the relevant account details and any supporting documents.

Let us know the account information and any proof of ownership you have, and we’ll begin the review.

Thanks,
Meridian Support
